packetIssues.issue: The PDF states redshift z = 6 and gives the Lyman-alpha laboratory wavelength as 1216 angstroms, but its answer is 7300 angstroms. Using the redshift relation λobserved = (1 + z)λlaboratory gives 8512 angstroms (about 8500 to two significant figures). The printed answer 7300 appears to use z × 1216 instead of (1 + z) × 1216.
